newsitem.title: USA: American Image named in lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: American Image named in lawsuit.

text.p: American Image Motor Co and the newsletter Global Financial Traders Ltd were named in a lawsuit that alleges they misled investors, a lawyer said Thursday.

The suit, filed in U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, alleges that American Image, some of its executives and the newsletter manipulated the company's stock, the lawyer, Thomas Romans, said in a statement.
American Image, based in Santa Cruz, Calif., was not available for comment.
Romans represents the plaintiff, Peter Ellison, who filed the suit on behalf of shareholders who bought American Image stock between September 23, 1996, and March 13, 1997.
